# Reference Figures

This gallery preserves the published visual analysis from **Jens Bender's `loan-default-prediction` repository** for reference while this repository is independently rebuilt.

**Important:** these figures are upstream artifacts. They are not results generated by `ML-Credit-Risk-Engine` and must not be cited as this project's experimental results.

Source: https://github.com/JensBender/loan-default-prediction

## Provenance

The upstream project is the sole source of the figures on this page. The original filenames and visual content are preserved through direct links to the upstream repository so provenance remains explicit.

Once the independent implementation is complete, newly generated figures should live under `reports/figures/` and be referenced separately from this gallery.
